basic_info.description: Updated & move-in ready, this beautifully refreshed home sits in Daly Citys desirable Westlake Olympic neighborhood. A bright living room with fireplace and adjoining dining area create warm, inviting spaces, complemented by hardwood floors throughout. Upstairs youll find a primary suite with an updated ensuite bathroom and an additional bedroom with an updated hallway bath, while the lower level offers a versatile room with private entrance and full bathperfect for guests, extended family, or a home office. The renovated kitchen showcases quartz countertops, refinished cabinetry with modern hardware, stainless steel appliances and sink, and recessed lighting. Significant upgrades include a new roof and gutters (installed 2024), fresh interior and exterior paint and a new LG refrigerator. Additional highlights include a large backyard for outdoor enjoyment, in-garage laundry, one-car parking, and a whole-home water filtration system. Ideally located near BART, I-280/35, Westlake Shopping Center, the Olympic Club, SF Golf Club, Lake Merced, and just minutes from San Francisco. A rare blend of charm, comfort, and conveniencethis home is ready for you to enjoy.
